messages:
Emily (Sales): ACME is ready to move to a POC. They need enterprise auth: SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, RBAC mapping, and domain controls. Also asked about POC pricing and setup. Can we put together the quick answers and a checklist for their IdP team?

Raj (Security): We support SAML 2.0 (both SP and IdP initiated). Required: signed assertions. Encryption is optional but supported. We publish SP metadata (EntityID + ACS). Important claims: email attribute required; groups claim recommended for immediate group assignment.

Lina (Sales Eng): SCIM details: endpoints follow RFC7643/7644. Base: https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2. Endpoints: /Users and /Groups. Auth: Bearer provisioning token. Supports standard attributes: userName, name, emails, active. We also accept a groups array and an extension for role hints.

Raj (Security): RBAC: default roles = admin, developer, viewer. Console supports mapping from SCIM group UUID or SAML group claim to roles. You can also create custom role templates scoped to the org. Provisioning events are logged and retained for 90 days.

Michael (Product): Docs you can share: https://docs.redwood.ai/enterprise-sso (public) and internal runbook at https://redwood.internal/docs/enterprise-auth. For POC we offer a 30-day hosted trial with SSO/SCIM turned on. Dedicated/private customers get SSO in the enterprise plan.

Lina (Sales Eng): SCIM sample payload to give ACME (for Okta / Azure AD):
```
POST https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users
Authorization: Bearer PROVISIONING_TOKEN
{
  "userName": "j.doe@acme.com",
  "name": { "givenName": "Jane", "familyName": "Doe" },
  "emails": [{ "value": "j.doe@acme.com", "primary": true }],
  "active": true,
  "groups": ["eng-team"],
  "urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:redwood:2.0:User": {
    "roles": ["developer"]
  }
}
```

Emily (Sales): ACME specifically asked about IdP-initiated login and JIT provisioning. Quick answer?

Raj (Security): Yes to both. IdP-initiated SSO works. JIT (Just-in-Time) provisioning via SAML is supported, provided the assertion contains the email claim. But we strongly recommend SCIM for reliable group syncing and deterministic role mappings.

Emily (Sales): They also want domain enforcement (only allow @acme.com). What's supported?

Michael (Product): We have domain controls in the Console: verified domains whitelist, require SAML domain match, and option to block invites from non-verified domains. For Hosted, domain verification uses DNS TXT. For Dedicated/Private installs you can enforce org-level domain-only sign-up.

Lina (Sales Eng): Minimal SAML SP metadata snippet to hand to their IdP team:
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood.ai/saml/sp">
  <SPSSODescriptor>
    <AssertionConsumerService Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST" Location="https://api.redwood.ai/saml/acs" />
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```

Emily (Sales): Pricing/POC terms for ACME (~150 seats)? Can we give a standard POC package?

Lina (Sales Eng): Typical POC flow: 30-day hosted trial with SSO & SCIM, no setup fee, includes one dev hour for integration support. Commercial pricing for 150 seats: we can propose seat-based Dedicated pricing or committed throughput. I'll open a preliminary quote with Finance.

Emily (Sales): Can someone draft a one-page checklist I can send the IdP team that lists endpoints, required claims, and sample metadata?

Lina (Sales Eng): Draft checklist below — feel free to copy/paste to ACME: 
- IdP vendor (Okta/Azure/Google)
- SAML ACS URL: https://api.redwood.ai/saml/acs
- SP EntityID: https://redwood.ai/saml/sp
- Required SAML claims: email (mandatory), groups (recommended)
- Accepts IdP-initiated and SP-initiated SSO
- SCIM base URL: https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2 (POST/GET/PATCH/DELETE)
- Provisioning auth: Bearer PROVISIONING_TOKEN (generate in Console)
- Group->Role mapping: configure in Console (map SAML group claim or SCIM group id to role)
- Domain control: provide domain to verify (e.g., acme.com); Hosted uses DNS TXT verification

Emily (Sales): Perfect. Please paste the security questionnaire snippets and SOC2 link into CRM.

sales-crm-bot: Opportunity RED-OPP-6243 updated  171 - notes added: SSO/SCIM POC 30d trial, requested quote. https://crm.redwood.internal/RED-OPP-6243

Raj (Security): I'll prepare the security questionnaire answers for SAML/SCIM/RBAC and attach EOD. Will include sample metadata and logs retention policy.

Emily (Sales): Thanks all
